# `nlink-lab link set`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Change a link: its MTU (both ends, live) or an endpoint's root qdisc (impairments are `impair`'s)

Usage: nlink-lab link set [OPTIONS] <ENDPOINT>

Arguments:
  <ENDPOINT>
          

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

      --mtu <MTU>
          The MTU of both ends (68 to 65535)

      --qdisc <KIND[,K=V…]>
          A root qdisc on the endpoint: `tbf,rate=10mbit,burst=32kb,limit=100kb`, `fq_codel,target=5ms,ecn`, `sfq,perturb=10s`, `prio,bands=3`

      --clear-qdisc
          Remove the endpoint's qdisc block

      --dry-run
          Show the plan; change nothing

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
